snippet.title: Jet gameplay (PC Game, 1985)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for Jet, Dos PC game produced by subLOGIC in 1985 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/jet/4102/
Jet is a simulation of both the F-16 Fighting Falcon and the F-18 Hornet Jet fighters. In this game you have possibility to play different scenarios very interesting.
Played through Dosbox emulation platform.
Recorded with original sound.

Similar videos you may like:
Silpheed - https://youtu.be/TCJlT8tAwRw
Lock-On - https://youtu.be/ZVo-8DZsDF0
Empire! - https://youtu.be/nY7BbU4pX6M
